description: Search a store by keyword, using the store's own relevance ranking. Returns compact rows with the id you need for get_app.

country.description: ISO-2 storefront code, e.g. us, gb, de, jp. Defaults to us.

lang.description: Language code, e.g. en, es, fr, ja. Defaults to en.

query.description: Keyword(s) to search for, e.g. 'meditation', 'photo editor'.

store.description: Store to query: "ios" (Apple App Store) or "android" (Google Play).

name: search_apps
title: Search apps
